stem: In the 4 weeks before a promotion, a Voltmarkt soundbar sold 18, 22 and 20 units in three of the weeks. In the remaining week it sold nothing, so the sales data has no row for that week. During the 2-week promotion it sold 39 and 51 units. Using Voltmarkt's convention for promo uplift, what is the uplift? Give it as a percentage with 1 decimal.
